title: Korean Tuna Rice Bowl
description: A flavorful and easy Korean-inspired tuna rice bowl with vegetables, avocado, and spicy mayo.

ingredients.item: Furikake (Japanese rice seasoning) in the Asian section of grocery store

steps: Prepare cooked rice as a base.
Slice carrots and potatoes into small pieces.
Mix the tuna with some chili sauce to taste.
Assemble the bowl by placing rice at the bottom, then topping with tuna, carrots, potatoes, and avocado.
Add a dollop of Q.P. mayonnaise on top.
Add seaweed on top or around the bowl.
Optionally, add cooked bulgogi for extra flavor.
notes:
Adjust chili sauce to preferred spice level. Optional ingredients like bulgogi can be added for extra flavor.

Source: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AGzmZ7MwM/

Nutrition: Serving 1 bowl · Calories Approximately 500 kcal per serving · Fat 20g · Saturated fat 3g · Unsaturated fat 17g · Trans fat 0g · Cholesterol 30mg · Sodium 700mg · Carbs 60g · Fiber 8g · Sugar 5g · Protein 25g

healthy: Carrots, potatoes, avocado and seaweed add vegetables and fiber.
not_healthy: Mayo adds a lot of fat.
Canned seasoned tuna, furikake and chili sauce add sodium.
